title: SSH MCP Server Configuration
description: Configuration schema for SSH MCP server defining remote SSH connections and security settings

servers.description: List of SSH server configurations. Each server can be accessed via MCP tools.

keys.description: Named SSH private keys that can be referenced by alias in server auth. Keys can be file paths or inline PEM content.

additionalProperties.description: SSH private key: file path (e.g., ~/.ssh/id_rsa) or inline PEM content

examples.deploy-key: -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\n...\n-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----

defaults.description: Default settings applied to all servers unless overridden

id.description: Unique identifier for this server. Used in MCP tool calls to target specific servers.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SSH server

auth.description: Authentication method: password or privateKey (mutually exclusive)

password.description: SSH password. WARNING: Store config file with 0600 permissions. Consider using SSH keys instead.

privateKey.description: SSH private key. Auto-detected: (1) inline PEM if starts with '-----BEGIN', (2) alias into top-level 'keys' (aliases may hold inline PEM OR file paths), (3) file path otherwise (~ expanded).

passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for encrypted private key

agent.description: Use SSH agent authentication (ssh-agent, 1Password, macOS Keychain - anything exposing SSH_AUTH_SOCK). No secrets stored in this config.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this server

shell.description: Remote shell type. 'auto' (default) detects the shell from the initial prompt. Use 'powershell' for Windows PowerShell, 'cmd' for Windows cmd.exe, or 'posix' for bash/sh/zsh to skip auto-detection.

agentForward.description: Allow SSH agent forwarding capability. When true (default), the execute tool can enable agent forwarding per-request.

connection.description: Maximum time to establish SSH connection (seconds)

idle.description: Maximum idle time before closing connection (seconds)

connectionPool.description: Connection pooling settings for reusing SSH connections

maxConnections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections per server

reuseConnections.description: Whether to reuse existing connections for multiple commands
